messages:
Priya (PM): quick brain-dump on rollout approach for the Q2 feature set. goal: low-risk ramp, measurable quality checks, and cost-aware fallbacks. posting so we can lock the spec.
Noor (Eng): love it. prefer mixing shadow testing + small live cohorts before committing traffic. can you outline the exact cohorts?
Priya (PM): cohorts: internal-devs, shadow-only (10%), measured beta (5% of traffic split A/B 50/50 to measure quality delta), regional warm (eu-us) then global ramp. each cohort has a burn-in and an evaluation gate.
Lila (Infra): shadow-only should still hit real infra but not affect billing. we can route to warm pools with tag rt:shadow and keep caches hot. need tenant list to pre-warm.
Akira (SRE): critical abort rules proposal: (1) safety: error-rate > 0.8% for 10m, (2) perf: median latency > 1.3x baseline for 5m, (3) cost: tokens / resp > +25% sustained for 15m, (4) QA: A/B quality delta > 3% on golden set. if any rule trips -> stepwise rollback ladder.
Jo (ProductOps): manual QA flow: 2 rotating reviewers, fresh cohort of 50 examples every hour in measured beta. auto-eval runs every 5k requests against golden prompts. reviewers flag regressions in a shared doc + slack thread.
Noor (Eng): rollback ladder: 1) stop traffic increase and reduce rollout percent, 2) switch cohort to compact-quant model, 3) route impacted cohort to hosted-stable model, 4) full flag-off. prefer automated first two, manual for 3+4.
Priya (PM): increment plan (measured beta): 0% -> 0.5% -> 2% -> 5% over 48h. each increment: hold 45m + automated checks. shadow-only runs concurrently but does not count toward percent.
Lila (Infra): autoscale policy: bounded burst (max replicas = baseline * 1.8) during measured beta. pool pin via node labels: pool:beta-warm-eu / pool:beta-warm-us.
Akira (SRE): statistical gate: require at least N=1000 requests per variant and p-value < 0.05 or bayesian credible interval excludes delta > 2.5%. If underpowered, hold and collect.
Noor (Eng): flag schema suggestion: single flag + rollout metadata. sample snippet:
```
flags:
  multi_response_v1.enabled: false
  multi_response_v1.rollout_steps: ["0.5%","2%","5%","25%","100%"]
  multi_response_v1.burn_in_minutes: 45
  multi_response_v1.eval_interval: 5000
  multi_response_v1.cost_threshold_percent: 25
```
CanaryBot: deploy-bot: reminder: add `--shadow` to test deploys. will post canary metrics to #canary-monitoring.
Jo (ProductOps): comms: beta emails + opt-out link for selected customers. also publish a short runbook FAQ about fallback behaviour.
Akira (SRE): auditing: require bypass header `X-RW-Bypass: <ticket-id>` with allowlist for engineers; log to audit-index.
Priya (PM): launch criteria (draft): infra pools + pre-warm done, flag config in staging, automated evals passing (no regression > 2.5%), SRE alerts wired, comms ready, legal sign-off for EU data. only then promote to measured beta.
Noor (Eng): scope note: I can deliver flag infra + shadow routing this sprint. A/B tooling + auto-evals needs one additional sprint unless we reuse existing eval infra.
Lila (Infra): will own pool tagging + pre-warm. need tenant IDs and expected QPS per tenant.
Akira (SRE): i'll author the runbook ladder and the emergency CLI commands for manual rollback. on-call check that escalation is < 10m.
Priya (PM): action items: @Noor implement flag + shadow routing, @Lila pre-warm pools, @Akira craft runbook + alerts, @Jo customer comms + review rota. i'll assemble final spec and calendar for kickoff. target: start shadow next Mon.
Jo (ProductOps): adding calendar invite + doc link when ready.
CanaryBot: incident-bot: scheduled monitor creation for #canary-monitoring 24h before shadow start.
Priya (PM): thanks all — will post spec shortly and loop in legal for EU checks. closing thread until spec is up.
